name: Shizuru Hakurou
source:
A werewolf who worships Ooizumi Genma for saving his life.

Werewolves were once worshipped until they were hunted down by humans. It is now an endangered species.

He dislikes humans and avoids them, because his parents were also killed by humans.

Attribute: Omega (Ω).
